items.sentence: Since on or about [MASK], to present, and after the route count and adjustment, she has not been paid correctly for working her route; 2.
From [MASK], to present, she has not been paid for overtime and/or holiday work; 2 and 3.
On [MASK], her request for package assistance on her route was denied.
The Agency subsequently issued a final order fully implementing the AJ’s finding that Complainant failed to prove that [MASK] subjected her to discrimination as alleged.

The AJ concluded that for claims 1 and 2, in which [MASK] alleged she had been discriminated against under GINA, Complainant failed to establish a prima facie case because she did not allege any facts related to the basis of genetic information.
